# gravitino_partition Resource

Manages a Gravitino partition within a table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravitino_partition" "example" {
  metalake = gravitino_metalake.example.name
  catalog  = gravitino_catalog.hive.name
  schema   = gravitino_schema.example.name
  table    = gravitino_table.example.name
  name     = "2024_q1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The partition name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.
- `table` (String) The table name.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the partition.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) The compound identifier in the format metalake.catalog.schema.table.partition.
